---
title: "Extension {{< meta ext_commit >}}: boards in tabs"
---

Built with the jsxgraph-quarto extension at {{< meta ext_label >}}. The
JSXGraph library is the same for every extension version: 1.14.0 from
jsDelivr. The figure code comes from old ctm-demo commits, as noted at each
board. Each extension version has its own copy of this page:
[a26aea8](../extension-a26aea8/index.html) (before PR #1) ·
[59d549c](../extension-59d549c/index.html) (upstream main, PR #1) ·
[17de83e](../extension-17de83e/index.html) (an earlier state of PR #2) ·
[overview and measurements](../index.html).

To test a board in a tab: load the page in a wide window, scroll so that the
tab bar is near the top of the window (a board that is off-screen when its
tab opens is drawn correctly when scrolled to, which hides the blank-board
problem), open the tabs named at the board, then make the window narrow
(about 390 px) and wide again.

## Visible at load (for comparison)

::: {#visible-solenoid .applet}
Solenoid, ctm-demo `60b1cb0` without its own resize code.

{{< include _applets/solenoid-plain.md >}}
:::

## In nested tabs, hidden at load

The tabs are laid out as on the course's physics page, with one extra first
tab, so that every board below is hidden when the page loads. The boards in
2025 → Prøve 3 and Prøve 4 sit in two hidden tabs, one inside the other.

::: {.panel-tabset}
